card.name: Words just before "market"
card.fires_on: Words right before an expected "market", such as "the", "to", "global" or "civilian", where the next word is likely "market". Seen in general business and economics text.

modes.label: Modifier before market
modes.description: An adjective that describes a kind of market, right before the word market.
modes.example: Georgian wine to make its mark in a highly competitive<< global>> market.

modes.label: Article or "to" before market
modes.description: The word "the" or "to" in phrases like enter the market, on the market, or out of the market.
modes.example: With Gilead's expensive Quad poised to enter<< the>> market, employers have started asking Steve Miller

card.writes: It lowers the chance that the next word is "market" or its translations, such as 市场.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "market" when the text is about to say it, and it pushes the model away from writing "market" next.
